products.name: PyTorch
products.note: Deep learning framework; model checkpoint governance; TorchServe deployment; research-to-production lineage

profile_text.body:
PyTorch.org is the home of the PyTorch Foundation, which describes itself as the deep learning community home for the open source PyTorch framework and ecosystem. The foundation operates under the Linux Foundation and is closely associated with Meta as a primary backer and originator of the project.

The central product tracked for this entity is PyTorch, an open source deep learning framework covering model checkpoint governance, deployment via TorchServe, and research-to-production lineage. The site also describes Captum, an open source and extensible library for model interpretability built on PyTorch, whose name derives from the Latin word for "comprehension."

The held facts confirm an active profile page for this entity but include no litigation, SEC filings, patent records, or MCP server registrations at this time.
